name: brewpage-publish
description: Host HTML pages and static sites, publish AI artifacts, and share Markdown, documents, reports or any file with BrewPage.

interface.shortDescription: Host HTML, static sites and AI artifacts; share any file.
interface.longDescription: Host HTML pages and static sites, publish AI artifacts, and share Markdown, documents, reports or any file with BrewPage.

skillInstructions: MCP-ONLY NATIVE OVERRIDE. Use the bundled skill and its references/publishing.md and references/ownership.md recipes as workflow guidance. Publish only through the connected BrewPage MCP tools using their actual schemas. Leave unsupported operations pending and name the missing capability. Do not use direct HTTP, bundled shell helpers, Claude runtime variables, or Claude configuration and history. The bundled Claude tool names and metadata grant no Kimi permissions. Ask the user directly for explicit namespace and password choices. Inspect only content the user selected for publication. Before any write that can return an owner token or private management link, verify that the MCP result is visible only to the requesting owner or goes through an authorized protected handoff. Saving a key after shared tool output cannot protect that output. Before a create that may issue a new key, arrange authorized native private storage or verified owner-only delivery. If a required boundary is unverified, leave the write pending and explain what is missing. Give the exact returned reader link and relevant notices. Deliver private management links or owner proof only through the verified protected channel. Anyone with a management link can manage that page. Say a key was saved only after native private readback. Keep private capability values out of shared output. For an uncertain result, reconcile through the selected owner's receipt or inventory before another write. These instructions govern the agent and the actual Kimi capabilities still govern execution.
